grades.quote: If the Respondent is a Student, the Complaint will be processed under the Student Conduct policy.

The Act requires BC post-secondary institutions to establish, implement, and make publicly available a policy, with associated procedures, that addresses sexual misconduct, its prevention, and responses to sexual misconduct.
An individual who has experienced, witnessed, or has knowledge of Sexual Violence and Misconduct can report the incident in a number of ways:

The University understands that individuals who have experienced Sexual Violence and Misconduct may wish to control whether and how their experience will be dealt with by the police and/or the University.
The University will respond in a timely manner to Disclosures, Complaints, and Reports of Sexual Violence and Misconduct.

During an evaluation of a Disclosure, Report or Complaint, or during an Investigation, the University may impose interim measures as deemed appropriate for the safety of the individuals involved and/or the University community.

The Policy applies in any situation where Sexual Violence and Misconduct occurs on University property or is related to University business, and includes activity that occurs in virtual environments including all forms of digital, electronic, or social media.
As required by the Act the University President must report to the Board on the implementation of the Policy.
As per the Act, this Policy will be reviewed at least once every three years or as directed by the Minister of Advanced Education.
Students and employees will be consulted as part of this review.
The University will invest in ongoing sexual violence education, awareness and prevention programming.
